trust_decision.summary: Whether an untrusted spatial-lookup RHS value (str / Path / dict / JSON string) may be turned into a GDALRaster (which opens VSI paths or creates a dataset in write mode) is decided in BaseSpatialField.get_prep_value/get_raster_prep_value; at the pinned commit any str is fed to GDALRaster and dicts are always fed to it.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'spatial lookups ... through GDAL raster parsing'; get_prep_value is the lookup value preparation that calls get_raster_prep_value -> gdal.GDALRaster(value).

fix_sites.entry_point: QuerySet.filter/exclude(<spatial_field>__<gis_lookup>=value) and admin changelist querystring filter (ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed, django/contrib/admin/options.py:500 -> get_changelist_instance :908)
same ORM lookup / admin changelist path (get_prep_value via Lookup.get_prep_lookup)
fix_sites.module_kind: ORM field value preparation (get_prep_value error/deferral logic)

fix_sites.entry_point: GDALRaster(ds_input) public GDAL wrapper API; fix factors out _preprocess_input (JSON str -> dict, Path -> str) and adds check_raster_lookup_value used by the field
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level GDAL ctypes wrapper (input normalisation + new check helper)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: django/contrib/gis/gdal/raster/source.py:80-87 (JSON-string -> dict and Path -> str normalisation inside GDALRaster.__init__; fix.diff:111-159 moves it into _preprocess_input/check_raster_lookup_value)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: GDALRaster is a general-purpose public wrapper whose dict/JSON/path inputs are documented and must keep working for model assignment and warp(), so a solver reasons 'the wrapper is fine, only the lookup branch for dict needs a guard' and never mirrors the wrapper's own JSON-string->dict conversion in the field check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: GeoJSON geometry strings match the same json_regex that makes GDALRaster treat a string as a raster dict, and must still work as geometry lookups; bytes (WKB / in-memory raster) and explicit GDALRaster objects must also still be accepted. Blocking every json_regex string or every non-GEOS type breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: JSON string matching json_regex (incl. leading whitespace)
dict/str inside a (value, band/distance) tuple for distance/relate lookups

O7_producer.where: django/contrib/gis/gdal/raster/source.py:80-83 (str matching json_regex is json.loads'ed into a dict that then reaches create_ds at :126-170)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a GIS Func that accepts a raster Value argument and coerces non-GEOS/non-GDALRaster values with GDALRaster(value) instead of raising TypeError
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GeoFuncMixin already coerces Value arguments for geometry positions; a maintainer adding raster function support (e.g. a band/value function) would naturally mirror the field's raster coercion.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: check_raster converting a non-GDALRaster dict/str rhs into GDALRaster to decide rhs_is_raster for band-index lookups
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: check_raster already branches on whether rhs is a raster; coercing there to support band indices on JSON input is a plausible convenience, in a backend package far from the field.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a RasterField.get_prep_value override (or to_python) that builds GDALRaster from str/dict before delegating, bypassing the base-class check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: RasterField already specialises from_db_value/contribute_to_class; a subclass-level prep for raster-only fields is a natural second implementation.

O9_family: CWE-73 external control of file name/path (untrusted value reaches GDAL open/create: file write and SSRF via VSI paths)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Guard only the `elif isinstance(value, dict)` branch (or only '/vsicurl' prefixes) in get_raster_prep_value, leaving JSON strings (converted to dicts inside GDALRaster), other /vsi prefixes and pathlib.Path open; or block in GDALRaster.__init__ globally and break documented model assignment.

out_of_scope_notes: RasterField has no form_class, so ModelForm/admin change forms use a plain CharField (django/db/models/fields/__init__.py:1188-1189) whose str value is assigned and turned into GDALRaster on access via SpatialProxy (django/contrib/gis/db/models/proxy.py:61-66, :46); the fix's docs explicitly keep assignment unprotected (fix.diff:216-223), so not an uncovered route of this advisory.
